title.narrative: Expanding Opportunities for Women’s Engagement in the Private Sector

description.narrative: Impact/Overall Objective:?Greater gender inclusiveness and equitability in economic growth is achieved.Intermediate impacts:?Sustainable development: More women run competitive, resilient and green businesses contributing to the sustainable local development.?Increased influence: Economically empowered women are better positioned to voice their interests and better exercise rightsSpecific objectives/Outcomes:1. Women are empowered to engage in the private sector activities as entrepreneurs and business owners.2. Public-private partnerships are forged to counter gender-specific barriers in accessing jobs and developing careers in business sector.Outputs:Output 1.1 Capacities of rural women to start up and grow viable businesses are built.Output 1.2 Performance of existing women-led small and micro-businesses is enhanced.Output 2.1. Employers have deeper understanding of family support needs and available solutions.Output 2.2. Auditable standard-setting certification programme in gender equality - Gender Equality Seal - is promoted among private companies.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
